resolutions.researcher_notes: Value StartYear1=2028 (start of operations). Current ref was the aramco.com press release, which now ReadTimeouts (dead/blocked). JPT (SPE): 'raising the Kingdom's total capacity by an additional 3.15 Bcf/D by 2028 by installing 4000 km of pipelines and 17 new gas compression trains'; MGS-3 construction began Q2 2024, completion targeted Q4 2028. OGJ corroborates the 2028 MGS-3 timeline independently. Two independent trade journals support 2028. Note: sources give project-wide MGS-3 completion by 2028; they do not name the individual segment BGCS-10-STS-2/EWJZG-1 (that granularity is not public), but 2028 is the correct start-of-operations year for the whole phase-3 buildout. No contradiction.

Value StartCountryOrArea=EndCountryOrArea=Saudi Arabia. JPT: 'Aramco's MGS is an extensive network of pipelines connecting Saudi Arabia's key gas production and processing sites'; the phase-3 packages 'relate to laying gas transport pipelines at various locations in the kingdom.' OGJ likewise places the MGS-3 pipelines in Saudi Arabia. Both sources 200 + contain 'Saudi'. Two independent sources confirm the line is wholly within Saudi Arabia. No contradiction.

Value Owner1=Aramco 100.00%. Prior refs (aramco.com press release + a MEED URL) were dead/timeout for the aramco one; MEED URL is live (200) but paywalled so the value token isn't fetchable. JPT: 'Aramco announced 15 lump-sum turnkey contracts...' for the MGS phase-3 expansion, and 'Aramco's MGS' is Aramco's own network — i.e. Aramco is owner/operator. OGJ independently frames MGS-3 as Aramco's project and lists Aramco as the awarding owner. Contractors (Sinopec/Kalpataru/L&T etc.) are EPC builders, not owners. Two independent sources confirm sole Aramco ownership. No contradiction.
